I'm the doctor, and some people find it hard to believe I'm a time lord from the planet Gallifrey, although I try not to let it show, unless there's company around.
them. My people allowed me to go wondering at a universe tinkering here and there, but occasionally they called me to account for my actions, normally when I'd overstepped the mark for some trifle or another.
source: Tom Baker · Doctor Who: Scratchman, narrated by Tom Baker
